description: The image displays three separate pie charts, each illustrating proportional distributions of specific linguistic or conceptual categories. The leftmost chart, titled “Categorical,” is divided into four segments: “Existential Quantifiers” (15.12%, light green), “Negation” (27.91%, orange), “Universal Quantifiers” (29.07%, light blue-gray), and “Limiter” (27.91%, light pink), with percentages labeled within each slice. The middle chart, “Approximate Number Generation,” contains four segments: “Absolute Absence” (18.71%, lavender), “Comparative Relationships” (36.26%, light blue), “Approximate Quantities” (45.03%, beige), and one unlabeled segment that appears to be the remainder. The rightmost chart, “Disjunctive & Conjunctive,” is split into two nearly equal parts: “Disjunctive” (49.51%, light blue-gray) and a second segment labeled “50.49%” in a light pink color, with no category name provided for the latter. All three charts include percentage labels within their respective slices and are visually organized with segments arranged in descending order of size, though no legend or additional visual emphasis such as exploded slices is present.
